[[File:23erAndMe-PnP.jpg|right|thumb|A 23er]]
'''23er''' was a slang word used to refer to veteran agents of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]].

Agents of Alliance Intelligence had to perform exactly twenty field assignments before facing mandatory retirement. Statistically, an operative had only a twenty-three percent chance of surviving to reach retirement, which led to the use of the term ''23er''.<ref name="RASB">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref>

A number of ''23ers'' worked as [[Alliance observer]]s.<ref name="PP12">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref>
